channel.description: macOS updates for Trails RG Studio (Sparkle)

item.title: Version 1.50.11 (143)
item.description:
Safer copy and paste

  • Copies are staged and verified before final publication.
  • Existing files are never overwritten.
  • Folder conflicts require Merge, Create copy, or Cancel.
  • Cut folders cannot merge into existing folders.
  • Tree paste uses the clicked destination and validates it first.
  • Detailed file and byte progress, cleaner folder tree, and fullscreen startup on macOS.
